title: Anonymization shouldn't break the original format/placeholders of the log files.
body:
**Description:**
Once ran the forgetme.sh, only the user's PII information(username in this case) should be anonymized but when consider the below example, "performedBy" part has been also getting replaced. This is not correct since if the log contents are processed for any other purpose by the user, it would be breaked due to this issue. Original placeholders should not be changed by anonymization.

[1] audit.log.temp.txt
```
[2018-03-07 15:14:14,561]  INFO -  {92536ede-52c8-4558-b7cd-ab50623b421f,"action":"created","typ":"Application","info":"{\"tier\":\"Unlimited\",\"name\":\"NewApp123\",\"callbackURL\":null}"}
```
[2] audit.log
```
[2018-03-07 15:14:14,561]  INFO -  {"performedBy":"wso2tester","action":"created","typ":"Application","info":"{\"tier\":\"Unlimited\",\"name\":\"NewApp123\",\"callbackURL\":null}"}
```

**Affected Product Version:**
wso2am-2.1.0-update13

**OS, DB, other environment details and versions:**    
macOs, JDK1.8, H2
